channel.title: Hidden Bar (floweredao fork)
channel.description: Updates for the floweredao fork of Hidden Bar.

item.title: Hidden Bar 1.11.1-fw.4
item.description:
Hidden Bar 1.11.1-fw.4

  • Hiding the separators (right-click or Option-click on the arrow) now hides both | separators, not only the always-hidden one.
  • Collapsing is one smooth step: the separators leave together with the hidden icons instead of the icons jumping first.

item.title: Hidden Bar 1.11.1-fw.3
item.description:
Hidden Bar 1.11.1-fw.3

  • No more lag: the arrow changes the moment you click, and the icons follow right after.
  • Left-click collapses and expands; right-click (or Control/Option-click) shows or hides the always-hidden section, like the classic app.
  • The arrow points the right way again, and Hidden Bar uses almost no CPU while idle.

item.title: Hidden Bar 1.11.1-fw.2
item.description:
Hidden Bar 1.11.1-fw.2

  • Hidden Bar now updates itself from this fork's own releases. Choose "Check for Updates…" from the right-click menu or the About tab, or let it check once a day.
  • Clicking the always-hidden "|" separator opens the menu again, so Preferences is reachable on macOS 27.
  • Many macOS 27 hiding fixes, Korean localization, and the source commit in the About tab.
